hero.subtitle: Join a team of passionate engineers, designers, and thinkers who are redefining how the world clicks. At Dragolink, we don't just route traffic—we build the infrastructure that secures and analyzes billions of digital interactions every day.

perks.title: Work from anywhere
perks.description: We are a remote-first company. Whether you prefer a home office, a co-working space, or a cabin in the woods, you can work from anywhere in the world.

perks.title: Comprehensive Healthcare
perks.description: 100% premium coverage for medical, dental, and vision for you and your dependents, plus mental health and wellness stipends.

perks.title: Unlimited PTO
perks.description: We hire adults and trust them to manage their time. Take the time you need to recharge, travel, and spend time with family. Mandatory 3-week minimum.

perks.title: Home Office Stipend
perks.description: Get a $2,000 stipend to set up your perfect workspace, plus a top-of-the-line MacBook Pro, monitor, and ergonomic chair on your first day.
